Alpine Linux security database data structure for parsing and representing SecDB vulnerability data.

## Key Components

### `SecDB`

The primary struct representing an Alpine Linux security database entry, containing:

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `Distroversion` | `string` | Alpine distro version (e.g., `v3.18`) |
| `Reponame` | `string` | Repository name (e.g., `main`, `community`) |
| `Urlprefix` | `string` | Base URL prefix for the security database |
| `Apkurl` | `string` | APK package URL template |
| `Packages` | `[]struct{...}` | List of packages with their security fixes |

Each entry in `Packages` contains a `Pkg` sub-struct with:
- `Name` — package name
- `Secfixes` — map of version strings to lists of CVE identifiers

## Usage Example

```go
db := alpine.SecDB{
    Distroversion: "v3.18",
    Reponame:      "main",
    Urlprefix:     "https://secdb.alpinelinux.org",
    Apkurl:        "https://dl-cdn.alpinelinux.org/alpine/v3.18/main",
    Packages: []struct {
        Pkg struct {
            Name     string
            Secfixes map[string][]string
        }
    }{
        {
            Pkg: struct {
                Name     string
                Secfixes map[string][]string
            }{
                Name: "curl",
                Secfixes: map[string][]string{
                    "8.1.2-r0": {"CVE-2023-28322", "CVE-2023-28321"},
                },
            },
        },
    },
}
```
